items.description: Generates Playwright test scripts from a target URL and a concise test specification.

items.name: crypto
items.description: Use this skill for any cryptocurrency or blockchain-related task. Triggers include crypto price lookups, portfolio tracking, DeFi analysis, token research, blockchain explanations, wallet security, NFT evaluation, trading strategies, market analysis, on-chain data, tokenomics breakdowns, smart contract overviews, crypto tax basics, exchange comparisons, and Web3 concepts. Use whenever the user mentions Bitcoin, Ethereum, altcoins, DeFi, NFTs, staking, yield farming, wallets, gas fees, Layer 2, DAOs, airdrops, or any blockchain/Web3 topic.
items.creator: 0x158e844d62afd5dbd66114a02b6166a5dec0e9d5

items.name: bankr-token-launch
items.description:
Turn a one-line brief into a token launch on Base — pick name/ticker/supply,
set sane defaults for an LP and a fair launch, and produce the exact steps an
agent runs to deploy and seed liquidity. Built for Bankr-style agent launches.
items.creator: 0x45d16139030e43c4efca91f07e144c29f8f46f02

items.name: premium-prompt
items.description:
A paywalled skill demo: the body (a high-value system prompt + decision tree) is
encrypted on IPFS and only decryptable after you invoke (pay for) the skill.
items.creator: 0x45d16139030e43c4efca91f07e144c29f8f46f02

items.name: base-token-swap
items.description:
Quote and route a token swap on Base across Aerodrome and Uniswap, pick the best
execution price, and build the approve + swap calldata with a hard slippage and
deadline guard. For agents trading onchain without a human in the loop.
items.creator: 0x45d16139030e43c4efca91f07e144c29f8f46f02

items.name: onchain-token-intel
items.description:
Due-diligence on any Base token in one call: holders and concentration, liquidity
depth and lock status, price and 24h volume, plus honeypot and owner-privilege risk
flags. Gives an agent a go / caution / avoid verdict before it trades.
items.creator: 0x45d16139030e43c4efca91f07e144c29f8f46f02

items.name: agent-wallet-ops
items.description:
The wallet primitives every onchain agent needs on Base: check ETH and token
balances, estimate gas, build exact-amount approvals, transfer tokens, and sanity
the nonce — with safety rails so an autonomous agent never overspends or stalls.
items.creator: 0x45d16139030e43c4efca91f07e144c29f8f46f02

items.name: pdf-toolkit
items.description:
Everything for working with PDF files: read/extract text and tables, merge and
split, rotate pages, add watermarks, fill forms, encrypt/decrypt, extract images,
and OCR scanned PDFs to make them searchable.
items.creator: 0x45d16139030e43c4efca91f07e144c29f8f46f02

items.name: mcp-server-builder
items.description:
Build high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that let LLMs interact with
external services through well-designed tools — in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript
(MCP SDK). Covers research, tool design, implementation, and evaluation.
items.creator: 0x45d16139030e43c4efca91f07e144c29f8f46f02

items.name: webapp-testing
items.description:
Interact with and test local web applications using Playwright: verify frontend
functionality, debug UI behavior, capture browser screenshots, and read browser logs.
items.creator: 0x45d16139030e43c4efca91f07e144c29f8f46f02

items.name: github-code-review
items.description:
Review pull requests and local changes before pushing: read diffs, leave inline
comments via the gh CLI or the GitHub REST API, and flag correctness and quality issues.
items.creator: 0x45d16139030e43c4efca91f07e144c29f8f46f02

items.name: jupyter-live-kernel
items.description:
Run a persistent Jupyter kernel for interactive data science: execute cells, keep
state across steps, inspect dataframes, and render plots — without re-running the world.
items.creator: 0x45d16139030e43c4efca91f07e144c29f8f46f02

items.name: openclaude-loop
items.description:
Run a prompt or command on a recurring interval, or self-paced, until a condition is
met — for polling status, babysitting long jobs, or repeating a task.
items.creator: 0x45d16139030e43c4efca91f07e144c29f8f46f02

items.name: cheapest-base-swap-with-slippage
items.description:
Provides a step‑by‑step guide to query the cheapest token swap on the Base network,
construct a transaction with a slippage guard, and submit it via a public RPC.
items.creator: 0x45d16139030e43c4efca91f07e144c29f8f46f02
